title: PerezBlanco2026: Wrist-motion (4-direction pointing) motor-execution dataset
description: A multimodal dataset of wrist movements recorded from 45 healthy participants performing a 4-direction pointing task (flexion, extension, radial deviation, ulnar deviation) with a 3-DoF wrist rehabilitation exoskeleton. It includes 8-channel EEG over sensorimotor areas and 8-channel EMG, recorded over multiple runs with continuous visual feedback. The dataset supports biomarker research and brain-computer interface development for neurorehabilitation. This BIDS release was produced from the published source data via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG and EMG were recorded at 512 Hz with a g.tec g.USBamp (8 EEG channels in a 10-10 montage, 8 EMG channels, right-ear reference, AFz ground, 0.1-200 Hz bandpass, 60 Hz notch). Participants controlled a cursor with a Biomech Wrist exoskeleton: flexion-extension moved it horizontally and radial-ulnar deviation moved it vertically. Each session had at least 8 runs of 40 cue-based trials (10 per movement per run).
